chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever takes a master other than his true masters, upon him is the curse of God, the angels, and all the people.

key_terms.تَوَلَّىٰ: To take as a master/leader or to appoint

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of following a leader other than the rightful Imam according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, establishes the theological principle of *Wali al-Ahd* (rightful authority) by linking loyalty to the Imams with divine favor and disloyalty with a comprehensive curse (*la'nat*). It underscores the Shia doctrine that allegiance to the Prophet's designated successors is not merely political but a fundamental condition of faith, extending the concept of *Walayah* to encompass both spiritual guidance and communal unity.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-271 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.) the Prophet (S) said, “
May God’s Curse of God, the angels, and all the people be upon whoever chooses a leader other than his true leader, or chooses a master other than his true master.”
